feedback.problem:
Which of the following values ​are possible outputs of  $f(x)={(1.5)}^{2x}-0.5?$ 

- $0$
- $-0.2$
- $-0.8$
feedback.worked_solution:
The range of ${(1.5)}^{x}$ is

$$
{(1.5)}^{x}>0.
$$

Horizontal shifts and stretches do not affect the range. Therefore,

$$
{(1.5)}^{2x}>0.
$$

Subtracting  $0.5$ from the above inequality yields the following:

$$
\begin{aligned}{(1.5)}^{2x} & >0 \\ {(1.5)}^{2x}-0.5 & >0-0.5 \\ f(x) & >-0.5\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the range is $f(x)>-0.5.$ Thus, of the given values, only $y=0$ and $y=-0.2$ are outputs of $y=f(x).$

We can also see that this is true from the graph of the function. The graph of $y=f(x)$ is shown below.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/13943819/assets/5876d2095bfd91417d2e6395f8a02ae817ebd476076bae929d79709ea7961a3e.png)

So, the correct answer is "I and II only."
